title: First integration
decision: Native integration domain, config entry and correct custom/Core version distinction.

title: Contributing to Core
decision: Fixed: top-level overlay now one platform/15 sensors; complete work retained in follow-up, not one large PR.

title: Integration file structure
decision: Renamed domain paths, manifests, tests/imports, shared modules and custom brand assets.

title: Integration test file structure
decision: Split tests into test_init, test_config_flow, test_sensor, test_controls and test_diagnostics as applicable.

title: Integration manifest
decision: Product name, valid domain, device/local_polling, Modbus dependency, exact library pin; custom-only version/issues.

title: Config flow
decision: Serial uniqueness and test-before-configure; millisecond gap; user input/reconfigure tested. Reconfigure only in full build.

title: Options flow
decision: Fixed: optional installation battery cap uses ConfigEntry.options and OptionsFlowWithReload; can be cleared.

title: YAML configuration
decision: UI setup only. Original YAML is immutable reference; optional helpers are not integration YAML configuration.

title: Diagnostics
decision: Full build only. Host/serial omitted, raw identity words removed, exception messages not exported; tests retained.

title: System health
decision: Reviewed, not added: no cloud endpoint/quota; coordinator, logs and diagnostics already describe local health.

title: Development checklist
decision: Pinned public dependency prerequisite, source distribution, issue tracker, generated metadata instructions, Ruff/typing.

title: Component review checklist
decision: No direct protocol implementation in Core. Current UI/runtime_data guidance takes precedence over older YAML examples.

title: Platform review checklist
decision: CoordinatorEntity lifecycle; no I/O in entity properties; cached reads, unique IDs, platform parallelism.

title: Modbus introduction
decision: Rechecked async_get_unit/temporary_unit and connection ownership; real shared-transport multi-unit test added.

title: Integration quality scale
decision: Bronze is a target, not an award. Library-publication and new-brand prerequisites remain todo.

title: Quality-scale checklist
decision: Every Bronze rule has implementation evidence or exemption; no unsupported claim that public steps are done.

title: PR review process
decision: Initial small PR plus sequenced future work, current dev/human review requirements; no PR opened.

title: Library introduction
decision: Standalone async typed library with OSI metadata, public issue/release preparation, editable development.

title: Library authentication
decision: Local Modbus has no authentication/OAuth. Caller injects the unit; no irrelevant HTTP auth/state storage added.

title: Library data models
decision: Native register fields retained; engineering scaling is wire decoding. Optional arithmetic stays separately exposed.

title: Packaging projects
decision: Hatchling minimum, SPDX licence expression, classifiers, lock, wheel/sdist build and Twine metadata validation.

title: HACS publishing start
decision: README, prepared repo description/topics/issues, hacs.json and full-release instructions.

title: HACS default inclusion
decision: Explicitly documented Core-testing/override exclusion; custom-repository distribution remains the supported route.

title: HACS integration requirements
decision: One custom_components domain, self-contained vendor tree, version/issue metadata, icon and validator workflows.

title: Sungrow upstream repository
decision: README plus installation, usage, FAQ, dashboards, migration and changelog read. Main YAML unchanged from supplied source.
